name: newrise0410
description: Orca orchestration skills that keep planner and builder sessions pinned across tasks and launch a fresh reviewer each unit, instead of respawning every session per task.

plugins.name: orca-pipeline
plugins.description: Three-role Orca pipeline — 기획(plan) → 기획검수(review) → 실행(build) — on pinned agent terminals reused across tasks. Asks which agent/model/effort staffs each role, keeps the planner and builder warm, and runs the reviewer cold every time.
